idea: Frost blades that turn round the caster like the hands of a clock, each unfurling outward and leaving a rising spiral crescent of rime behind it, so the area is drawn with travelling, turning arcs no existing kind can draw.
intent: Three pale ice-blue blades sweep a full turn round the caster in half a second, unfurling out to the circle's edge and trailing a climbing crescent of rime that fades behind them; with power the blades reach further, thicken and the rime climbs higher, at the same 22 parts.
requests: A painted frost-crystal particle texture; the Puff is the closest of the allowed set.
A bent-blade primitive: blades are straight cylinders, so the sweep's curve is carried by the rising rime crescent instead.
